name: Motor-Driven Cycle
description: A motorcycle or motor scooter whose motor doesn't exceed 5 horsepower (3,750 W). An electric two- or three-wheeler too fast or powerful to be a motorized bicycle, or without pedals, lands here until it passes 5 horsepower. Defined by Louisiana Revised Statutes §32:1(49).

restrictions.rule: A motorcycle, including a motor scooter: a seat or saddle and no more than three wheels on the ground
Its motor doesn't exceed 5 horsepower (3,750 W)
A motor vehicle, so titled, registered and plated with the Office of Motor Vehicles, with liability insurance
The Office of Motor Vehicles requires a motorcycle (M) endorsement on the rider's driver's license
Riders must wear a motorcycle safety helmet secured with a chin strap
Riders must wear approved eye protection unless it has a windshield tall enough to protect their eyes
